findings.title: Fingerprint pass is not mirror authenticity
findings.detail: SHA-256 + length + Git blob SHA-1 verification proves FILE IDENTITY with the pinned mirror commit only. It does not authenticate the mirror as an official Tanzil release, nor scripture authenticity. Manifest and all outputs keep source_authenticated=false, authority_status=not_authenticated.

findings.title: Windows symlink test not locally qualified
findings.detail: test_symlink_alias_refused requires symlink privileges unavailable to the local Windows operator (WinError 1314). Locally: 16/17 pass + 1 privilege error. On Ubuntu CI the symlink test executes and the Q0.1b workflow is green on this exact head. Refusal logic itself was code-reviewed (symlink rejection before any read).

findings.title: No network in module; ephemeral fetch confined to CI workflow
Dual independent digests: SHA-256+length AND Git blob SHA-1 for unverified mirrors
114/6236 topology + Tanzil license notice validated; no text rewriting
INPUT_ERROR branch prints untruncated str(exc); RawSourceError messages are fixed strings so leak risk is minimal — consider truncation for symmetry
CLI exit codes 0/1/2 documented; find matches are mark-folding in MATCHING ONLY, never in returned text
